create_lora_manager: create a LoRAManager to serve multiple LoRA adapters on a base model
load_lora_adapter: load a LoRA adapter from a path into the LoRA memory pool
unload_lora_adapter: unload a LoRA adapter from the memory pool and delete its LoRA modules
validate_lora_batch: validate if a set of LoRA IDs in a batch fits the memory pool constraints
prepare_lora_batch: prepare batch metadata for LoRA inference with CUDA graph support
fetch_new_loras: fetch and prepare new LoRA adapters into the memory pool for a batch
update_lora_info: update all LoRA modules with the latest memory buffer references
init_lora_shapes: infer LoRA target modules and max rank from loaded adapter configs
init_memory_pool: initialize the LoRA memory pool with current adapter configurations
